summary: Steven Grunwald, 24, of Greenville, NY, last contacted family August 28 and was believed to have attempted the Glacier Gorge Traverse on August 29; reported missing September 10 after his vehicle was found at the Glacier Gorge Trailhead; body found September 14 in the Notch below McHenrys and Powell Peaks.
location: The Notch below McHenrys and Powell Peaks, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park SAR, Northern Colorado Interagency Helitak, Front Range Rescue Dogs
notes: Date is the believed start of the traverse (last contact Aug 28); body recovered by helicopter Sept 14. Cause under investigation at time of NPS release; no fall established in opened sources, classified lost/stranded. Name widely published (NPS release).
